tei:titleStmt.tei:title: תפלה לפני הניתוח
Prayer Immediately Before Vaginoplasty Surgery, by the Em haBanim

tei:div.tei:head: Prayer Immediately Before Vaginoplasty Surgery, by the Em haBanim

tei:l.tei:note: While you are waiting in the hospital, pray the prayer from the night before. And then read Psalms 35 with the intention to rejoice in Hashem’s redemption despite those who seek your life and plan evil towards you and your people. When you say the words all my bones declare, meditate on uniting your soul with all the parts of your body. And afterwards read other psalms until you are brought into the operating room. And immediately before you go under for surgery, say:

tei:lg.tei:l: Like the shattering of the pact written on the tablet,
Take the eggs and give the mother freedom,
Awaken me, G-d, beneath the apple tree.
My Lover, my Maker, who breathed life into me,
Please create for me an open opening.
